The italic newsletter line at the bottom is cut off by the footer, and the real one is a little lower (y about 730).","fix":"Shift the paragraph text block down 1px (from y213 to y214 for the first line). Reduce letter-spacing by about 0.2px, or set the font-size to 16.7px, so line widths match. Keep the line-height at 24px. Use font-weight 400 and color #1a1a1a."},{"element_id":"s29","problem":"The hero photo art spans only x40..411 (rect x40,y0,w371.4,h168.3). The area from x20 to 40 is uncovered, and the heatmap shows red at the left and along the top edge.","fix":"Draw assets/s29.e01.art.png at its listed rect (x40,y0,w371.4,h168.3) and fill x20..40 with the same photo, extending it by cropping. The photo should span x20 to 391, ending at y160 with a 1px #ddd line under it."},{"element_id":"s29","problem":"The caption 'Amber Glenn on 'Dancing With the Stars'Credit: abc' is about 1px higher and a bit wider than the real one (it ends about x318 on the real screen).","fix":"Set the caption to 14px, color #6b6b6b, letter-spacing -0.1px, and move it down 1px to y about 179. It should end near x318."},{"element_id":"s30","problem":"The caption at the top, which is cut off at the left ('iber Glenn...'), and all paragraphs show red streaks. The mock text is slightly wider and the caption is 1px too high. The 'EW Dispatch newsletter' line is 1px too high in the mock (y595 vs 596).","fix":"Narrow the text tracking by about 0.2px and shift the body down 1px. The caption should end near x318, not x340. Move the italic bold newsletter line down 1px."},{"element_id":"s31","problem":"Body text is slightly too wide, so lines such as 'show is about growth. I'm seeing true growth,' she said.' run past x390 (the real one ends at x386). Every paragraph shows red streaks.","fix":"Reduce the body text width by about 1.5% with letter-spacing -0.2px. Keep line breaks the same. Move the italic line and the link down 1px."},{"element_id":"s31","problem":"The footer 'Next in More For You' card: the title and subtitle look slightly heavier and 1px off. The card's top border line differs from the real one, which is a thin gray line at y729.","fix":"Set the title to 15px weight 700 and the subtitle to 13px weight 400 with color #222. Put a 1px #ddd top border at y729 and use the card background #f3f6f9."},{"element_id":"s12","problem":"The Temu ad thumbnail (x28..93, y257..318) is a flat stand-in of blocks. The real screen shows a jacket collage with 'TEMU MEGA SALE' and '$2.36'. The ad title is bolder than the real one.","fix":"No listed picture covers the thumbnail, so draw it closer: a white background, a 'TEMU MEGA SALE' line in 6px black bold at the top, three jackets in white, navy #1f2a44 and gray #888, and '$2.36' in red #c00 6px bold below. Set the ad title to weight 600."},{"element_id":"s12","problem":"The title 'Kristi Noem Files for Divorce...' and the byline are about 1px off and slightly bolder. The 'Originally appeared on E! Online' line and the paragraph below are also a little wide.","fix":"Set the title to weight 600, letter-spacing -0.1px, and move it down 1px. Move 'Sasha Wayman' and 'Updated Sep. 29...' down 1px. Cut the body text tracking by 0.2px."}],"summary":"All tagged elements and taps already match, so the remaining gap is in visual detail: body text on the article screens is slightly too wide and about 1px high, which shows as red streaks across every paragraph on s29 to s31. This round should tighten the body tracking, correct the 1px vertical offset and the caption width, and fix the s29 hero photo's uncovered left strip. The s12 Temu thumbnail and title weight come next."}
